title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: Authentication bypass allows unauthorized administrator access.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and enforce secure authentication.

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
impact: Unsanitized input can execute JavaScript in a victim browser.
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding and validate user input.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting
impact: Stored malicious scripts can execute when users view affected content.
remediation: Sanitize stored HTML and use context-aware output encoding.
